name: Elfish humanoid
description: These elvish humanoids were a sentient species that lived on a small planetoid. They were ruled by a king until he was murdered during the invasion by the Yahk-Tosh warlord Lord Gar-Oth. The king's daughter, Princess Lourdes, managed to kill the invader with the help of Jedi Knight Yoshi Raph-Elan.
